title: The Smiling Harvest
author: Sebastian Sandoval
blurb: Felix Marchetti, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
